identification: John Tallis / J. Rapkin, 'Van Diemen's Island or Tasmania' (London, c.1851, from Tallis's Illustrated Atlas), steel engraving with vignettes of Hobart Town, the V.D.L. Company agent's residence at Circular Head and a thylacine. Fully hand coloured including the Greek-key border and vignettes (originals usually have outline colour only, so the full colour is later, or this is a reproduction). Framed in a modern ornate gilt frame with black mat; frame 60 x 48 cm, map approx 26 x 35 cm.
